1fc3d326-c037-43fa-8953-ed52a56caa18.altTitle: She Have a Crush on My Elder Brother, Maybe
1fc3d326-c037-43fa-8953-ed52a56caa18.description: A high school guy who doesn't trust girls anymore has been tricked too many times by girls who just wanted to get close to his good-looking older brother. After all that, he decides he'll never trust a girl again. But then, a pretty girl in his class suddenly starts talking to him a lot. Is she just trying to get to his brother too...? Or does she actually mean something else?

6f8509aa-dec9-4b92-aa20-014b14fa4d7f.altTitle: I Reincarnated as the Childhood Friend of the Final Boss Villainess Who Falls into Darkness. If I Die, It's a Guaranteed Bad End, so I Became the Strongest, but Hasn't She Already Fallen into Darkness (and Turned Yandere)?
6f8509aa-dec9-4b92-aa20-014b14fa4d7f.description:
“If you were to disappear… I might just lose myself.”

Arcs is reborn into the world of the wildly popular otome game Celestia Kingdom. He thought he was just a background character—until it's revealed he's actually the childhood friend of the final boss! Determined to avoid the bad ending, he throws himself into his daily life as her servant. But it seems the true cause of her descent into darkness is… her childhood friend!?

eff87780-93d9-412e-b831-c731787e9bea.description: Masatora Akutsu has just transferred into class in Japan from a long way away - all the way from Hell, to be exact. Akutsu is a demon who's come to Earth to find someone who can motivate the forces of Hell to fight back against the invading Heavenly army. He immediately sets his sights on one of his classmates, the kind and beautiful Lily Amane, but ends up in way over his head when it turns out Lily has some secrets of her own!

efaae0a6-0b38-4b9c-88bf-1059b8be6244.title: WORST 816
efaae0a6-0b38-4b9c-88bf-1059b8be6244.description:
Worst 816.

Worst 816 is a "one shot" manga that introduces the character Housen in the movie High and Low The Worst, especially Ozawa Hitoshi and Sabakan. Sachio is not featured in the manga at all.

This manga tells about Ozawa Hitoshi's daily life in Housen and also Sabakan's daily life in Housen. In this manga, a little bit of Sabakan's strength, the silhouette of the 2nd class frontman, and Ozawa Hitoshi's favorite drink are also shown.

This manga is suitable for those of you who want to see Ozawa Hitoshi or Sabakan in the manga version of Hiroshi Takahashi.

In Japan itself, this manga is not sold over-the-counter and is only given to audiences who watch High and Low The Worst in theaters.

b04582e8-d98b-4f6e-b605-c300f3a5e3bd.title: SANDA
b04582e8-d98b-4f6e-b605-c300f3a5e3bd.description:
In the year 2080, the world is like it is now, yet different. Government-arranged marriages, elaborate plastic surgery, and medical science are at the forefront of Japanese society.

Sanda Kazushige is a middle-school student who hasn't quite matured, despite being in the thralls of puberty. Put into a life-threatening situation by his classmate Fuyumura, Sanda discovers his uncanny ability to turn into a burly (and more grown) Santa Claus, and is thrown into a world of chaos to save his fellow students in only ways Santa Claus can do, while trying to solve the mysteries of the school he attends and the truth to where his supposedly-dead classmate Ono went.
